title: My Son in a morning
budget: 150,000 VND for a non-resident adult, plus the road. The child fare and the drive are check on arrival.
summary: One morning from Hoi An: the museum, the cart, and the brick towers. Not a night in the valley, and not a second day.

days.title: Morning — the valley
days.body: Leave Hoi An by road. The sanctuary prints 45 km and no drive time. At the gate, use the museum, then the electric cart for about 2 km, then the tower groups that are open. Be out before the close the board is using that day: 17:00 on the 2019 notice, or visiting until 18:00 on the live ticket site. Eat in Hoi An. The monument area does not allow food. Tourism bus 01DL is paused.

seoDescription: A half day at the Cham towers: 45 km from Hoi An, museum then cart, and out before the published close.
